prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” HVAC company in Houston — the best choice depends on your location in the metro area, the problem (simple repair vs. major system failure), your budget, and whether you want a big company or a local independent tech. That said, Houston has several well‑established, highly reviewed companies you can start with (and check locally for your ZIP):

- John Moore Services (well known in Houston for heating/AC/plumbing)
- Abacus Plumbing, AC & Electric (large local company with wide service area)

How to pick the best company for your specific situation
- Certifications and training: look for NATE‑certified techs and EPA 608 certification (required to handle refrigerants).  
- License & insurance: confirm they carry liability insurance and any required state/local registrations.  
- Warranties: ask about part and labor warranties and how long they last.  
- Up‑front pricing: get a written estimate and ask about diagnostic fees, flat‑rate vs. hourly billing.  
- Reviews & reputation: check Google, Yelp, BBB, and local Facebook groups for recent experiences (especially for the same repair you need).  
- Emergency response: ask about after‑hours availability and typical arrival windows.  
- Experience with your system: confirm they service your brand/model of AC and can source parts.  

Quick troubleshooting to try before calling
- Replace/clean the air filter.  
- Check your thermostat settings and batteries.  
- Make sure the breaker/fuse for the AC is ON.  
- If the outdoor unit isn’t running, check for ice on the coils (turn the system off and call a tech).

Typical cost expectations (very rough)
- Diagnostic visit: $75–$200.  
- Minor repairs (capacitor, contactor, sensors): $150–$600.  
- Major repairs (compressor, coil, refrigerant leaks): $800–$2,500+.  
- Full system replacement: often $3,500–$10,000+ depending on efficiency and capacity.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and a short description of the problem (no cool air, short cycling, strange noises, leak, etc.) and I’ll find the top-rated local AC repair companies near you, with recent ratings and contact suggestions.
